## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] Mathematical changes include deterministic tests and documented assumptions
- [ ] UI changes were checked at representative desktop and mobile sizes
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation
- [ ] New media has provenance and redistribution rights recorded
- [ ] No credentials, local files, build output, or copied commercial assets are included
- [ ] The change introduces no deposits, purchases, prizes, withdrawals, or cash-out behavior
